Aisha (PM): quick sync — I sketched a proposed set of release gates and a few exemption rules for the upcoming major release. want quick feedback before i formalize in the runbook
Devon (Eng): SGTM. can you paste the gate list here?
Aisha (PM): sure — top level: 1) SLA acceptance (p95 latency + error budgets), 2) docs & customer playbooks, 3) monitoring + synthetic checks green, 4) pricing + billing rules validated, 5) support runbook & oncall handoff done. exemptions allowed with approval from eng + pm.
Priya (Support): need clarity on "support runbook done" — is that "playbook exists" or "triage tabletop completed"?
Aisha (PM): good call. propose both: playbook doc + one tabletop with support+eng within 7 days of release. otherwise gate stays closed.
Tom (SRE): SLA acceptance: we need a load window and a p95 baseline. my proposal: run 48h production-like soak on dedicated pool, target p95 <= 200ms for hosted small instances, error rate < 0.2% (5xx + timeouts). if fail, must have rollback strategy.
Devon (Eng): 200ms p95 is aggressive for some models with longer contexts. can we scope by model class? e.g., Llama2-70B quantized: p95 <= 350ms. smaller open models: <=200ms.
Aisha (PM): yes — gate will be model-class aware. we'll add a mapping table in the runbook.
Lena (Pricing): for pricing readiness — we need billing test vectors + invoice preview for top 10 customers and default rate limits validated. also confirm unit economics calc doc exists.
Priya (Support): i'll own the tabletop and the customer-facing escalations doc. need someone from eng for the mock incident. Devon?
Devon (Eng): i can do the mock incident. propose we simulate fallback path: primary model out -> route to cheaper variant + notify app with 503->200 grace window. test the entire flow.
Tom (SRE): synth monitoring: 1) end-to-end generation latency, 2) kv/prefix cache hit rate, 3) tail token time, 4) model fallback events. alerts: p95 breach, cache hit < 70%, fallback > 1% per minute.
Aisha (PM): nice. i also want auto rollback threshold: if p95 > 2x baseline for 10m AND error rate > 1% -> auto rollback. action: eng to implement rollback hook in deploy pipeline.
Devon (Eng): we have deploy-bot support for hooks. i'll add a canary evaluation step and a rollback hook that triggers when the canary fails the metric check.
deploy-bot: canary job queued: release/major-2026-canary -> awaiting evaluation window
Lena (Pricing): small ask: update the pricing page copy to explicitly call out Dedicated reserved commit discounts and billing granularity (per 1k tokens for inference + per-embedding). do we have copy deadline?
Aisha (PM): need pricing copy + billing tests by EOD Tue. lena owns copy; finance + eng to sign off on invoice preview by Wed noon.
Priya (Support): doc checklist from support side: 1) playbook, 2) oncall rotation noted, 3) escalation contacts, 4) known limitations + troubleshooting steps, 5) canned customer response templates.
Aisha (PM): i'll add a GA gate matrix (checkboxes) to the runbook: each gate row with owner + acceptance criteria + evidence artifacts (links). also include approval flow: PM + Eng lead signoff required; legal or security can veto.
Tom (SRE): please include a short "post-deploy smoke" script we can run manually: example commands:
```
# smoke sample
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-small","prompt":"hello"}' | jq -r .status
# check metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/api/query?name=p95_latency | jq
```
Devon (Eng): will add the smoke script to the repo and the deploy job.
Aisha (PM): owners + deadlines: devon -> rollback/canary hook by Fri COB, tom -> synths & alerts by Fri COB, priya -> tabletop scheduled by next Tue, lena -> pricing copy by Tue EOD, aisha -> runbook assembled + gate matrix by Wed noon.
Priya (Support): noted. i'll ping support channel with the tabletop invite. :calendar: 
Lena (Pricing): will share copy in this thread when ready.
Devon (Eng): quick Q — can we allow a formal "SLA exception" process for top enterprise customers that need custom latency/SLOs? thinking documented contract path.
Aisha (PM): yes — add an "SLA exception" path in the runbook: requires legal + finance + eng capacity signoff and separate pricing + support commitments. not an automatic gate bypass.
Tom (SRE): one more: we should capture rollback runbook for data plane stateful operations (cache invalidation, long-lived sessions). if rollback leaves inconsistent state we need remediation steps.
Aisha (PM): agreed. i'll add a remediation checklist item.
Devon (Eng): sounds good. i'll start a PR with the canary checks + smoke scripts. tagging for followups: @Priya (Support), @Tom (SRE), @Lena (Pricing).
Aisha (PM): thanks all — i'll convert this thread into a short runbook draft and ping for signoffs. closing notes: gate must have evidence link (logs, canary report, docs link) else it's not accepted. :white_check_mark:
